en: Clay
Welcome to the Pokémon World Tournament! I built this hall for the city, so that Trainers from every region have somewhere to meet.
And you're just in time. The first tournament is about to begin. {rival} and Cheren have entered, and I'd like you in it too.
Receptionist
Welcome to the Pokémon World Tournament! The Driftveil Tournament is about to start. Clay is on the stage and will see you in.
Welcome to the Pokémon World Tournament! The Driftveil Tournament has been played, and the results are in the record books.
The tournaments of the other formats will open as their rules are drawn up. Please do come back!
Clay
The Driftveil Tournament is a knockout of eight Trainers. Three Pokémon each, at Level 50 or under, and nothing from the Bag.
Will you enter the Driftveil Tournament?
You need {number} Pokémon that can take part, all of different species and holding different items.
An Egg can't take part, and nor can {banned}.
Then choose the Pokémon you'll enter.
I'm sorry. The Pokémon entered must all be of different species.
I'm sorry. No two of the Pokémon entered may hold the same item.
Come back when your team is ready. The stage will wait.
No rush. The tournament isn't going anywhere, and neither am I.
Eight Trainers took the stage in the Driftveil Tournament, a knockout of three rounds.
Clay
First round! Let's hear it for the entrants!
Cheren
I'm not holding back, {player}. I want to see what you've learned since Aspertia.
Cheren
Well fought! You've earned your place in the next round.
{rival}
My turn, {player}! I've been waiting for this since we left the Gym. I won't lose!
{rival}
Argh! ...No, that was a good one. You go on and win it, {player}.
Clay
Well, well! Final round, and the last one standing's me. Ain't that how it goes? Don't you hold back on my account!
Clay
Haw haw! Lost to a youngster in my own hall, and I couldn't be gladder. That's a champion's battle you gave me, {player}.
The Driftveil Tournament's yours. Take these Battle Points, and be proud of 'em.
{player} received 5 BP!
Cheren
I'm sorry, {player}. That round was mine. You fought well, though: I can see how far you've come.
{rival}
Yes! I beat you, {player}! ...Heh. Next time it'll be an even closer one, I bet.
Clay
Haw haw! Still the top Trainer of my own hall! You came mighty close, though, {player}. Mighty close.
Clay
A tournament's about how you fight, not whether you win. You're welcome in this hall any time.
Clay
There's a big ship moored at the end of the pier, by the way. Go on and take a look when you've caught your breath.
